hints.title: Exact Dimension Compatibility
hints.text: The 1D array length must equal m multiplied by n. If not, constructing an m by n matrix is impossible.

hints.title: Row Chunk Slicing
hints.text: Each row r spans the contiguous subarray slice from r times n to r plus one times n.

hints.title: Reshape Construction
hints.text: Iterate from row index zero to m minus one and append each contiguous slice to the resulting 2D matrix.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(M * N) copying original elements into 2D grid
complexity.space: O(M * N) to store reshaped output matrix
complexity.notes: Direct indexing creates each row in optimal time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to check dimension product beforehand leads to indexing bounds errors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Output-sized memory allocation is strictly necessary.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should validate length equality first and cleanly slice array.
